name: Leather Armor
description: Cured animal hide reinforced with boiled leather plates to protect vital organs.

name: Studded Leather Armor
description: Supple leather reinforced with close-set rivets and iron studs.

name: Chain Shirt
description: Interlocking steel rings worn between layers of cloth or leather to absorb bludgeoning impact.

name: Breastplate
description: A fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather backing, leaving the limbs unencumbered.

description: A circular or kite shield of layered oak faced with iron bands.
